_source: Terminology checked against IMCA C005 (grades R20/R01/R02/R03/R04 and tooling R11-R14), API RP 17H (hot stabs, torque classes 1-4, ROV interfaces), IMCA metrology guides, GVI/CVI/DVI + CP + FMD inspection, and subsea construction glossaries (flexlay, tie-in, pre-comm, trenching, IMR).

flexlay.name: Flexlay campaign
scopes: ROV support to flexible lay operations, hot stab intervention and ROV equipment maintenance / tooling.
Flexible lay support - overboarding, touchdown monitoring and subsea connection of flexible risers and flowlines.
ROV support to flexlay: lay corridor survey, touchdown monitoring, pull-in and first end / second end connections.
Flexlay scope - reel-lay of flexible flowlines, pull-in to the structure and tie-in of the second end.
tasks: bend restrictor and bend stiffener installation
monitoring of the tensioners during overboarding

rigidlay.name: Rigid lay campaign
scopes: ROV support to rigid pipelay operations, touchdown monitoring and as-laid survey.
Pipelay support - S-lay / reel-lay operations, initiation, laydown and post-lay survey.
ROV support to rigid lay: initiation, touchdown monitoring, abandonment and recovery, and as-laid survey.
Rigid lay scope - J-lay tower support, PLET laydown and free span identification along the route.
tasks: stroke monitoring on the A&R wire

tie-in.name: Subsea tie-in campaign
scopes: ROV support to subsea tie-in, spool installation and connection of jumpers and flying leads.
Subsea tie-in scope - metrology, spool installation, connector stroking and leak testing.
ROV support to tie-in operations: metrology, rigging, spool landing and hydraulic connection.
Tie-in and jumper installation - direct pull-in, connector make up and flying lead installation.
tasks: torque operations on the clamp connector
AX and VX gasket change out

precomm.name: Pre-commissioning campaign
scopes: ROV support to pre-commissioning - flooding, gauging, hydrotesting and dewatering of the flowlines.
Pre-commissioning scope: hot stab operations, valve overrides and monitoring of flooding and dewatering.
ROV support to pre-comm and leak testing, including hot stab intervention and valve operations.
Pre-commissioning and commissioning support - system hydrotest, leak test and function testing of the subsea equipment.
tasks: hot stab intervention on the pre-comm panel
pressure monitoring at the subsea panel
function testing of the subsea valves

imr.name: IMR campaign
scopes: ROV support to inspection, maintenance and repair of subsea assets.
IMR scope - general visual inspection, CP readings, anode retrofit and valve intervention.
ROV support to IMR: GVI and CVI inspection, cleaning, CP survey and component change out.
Inspection, maintenance and repair - structure inspection, anomaly close out and subsea intervention.
tasks: flooded member detection on the braces and legs
close out of outstanding anomalies from the previous campaign
tooling: the cleaning brush and cavitation lance

survey.name: Survey campaign
scopes: ROV support to survey operations - pipeline and route survey, debris clearance and light construction.
Survey scope: multibeam and pipetracker survey, seabed classification and as-built verification.
ROV support to survey and light construction, including boulder clearance and route clearance.
Pipeline survey scope - GVI, CP survey, free span measurement and burial depth verification.

trenching.name: Trenching and backfill campaign
scopes: ROV support to trenching, backfill and rock placement operations.
Trenching scope - jet trencher support, burial depth verification and post-trench survey.
ROV support to burial operations, including trencher monitoring and depth of lowering survey.
Post-lay trenching and protection - trenching support, rock dump monitoring and mattress installation.

mobilisation.name: Mobilisation / M&R period
scopes: Vessel M&R period and mobilisation - ROV equipment maintenance, tooling integration and system testing.
Mobilisation scope: build up and testing of the ROV systems, tooling skids and LARS ahead of the campaign.
ROV equipment maintenance and mobilisation, including overhaul of the tooling and function testing.
Maintenance and repair period - planned maintenance, tooling integration and wet testing before the campaign.
tasks: hydraulic oil sampling and change out
fibre optic termination and OTDR testing
insulation resistance testing of the subsea power
tooling: the hand tools and test equipment

installation.name: Subsea installation campaign
scopes: ROV support to subsea installation of structures, manifolds and protection covers.
Installation scope - rigging, landing and orientation of subsea structures, and mattress installation.
ROV support to heavy lift installation, suction pile operations and structure alignment.
Subsea structure installation - manifold and PLET landing, orientation and removal of installation aids.

decom.name: Decommissioning campaign
scopes: ROV support to decommissioning - cutting, recovery of subsea structures and site clearance.
Decommissioning scope: disconnection, cutting operations and recovery of redundant equipment.
ROV support to removal and site clearance, including rigging and debris recovery.
Decommissioning and site clearance - isolation, cutting, rigging and recovery to deck.
tasks: removal of the anodes and clamps
confirmation of clear seabed after recovery

drillsupport.name: Drill support campaign
scopes: ROV support to drilling operations - wellhead monitoring, BOP intervention and seabed observation.
Drill support scope: BOP function testing, wellhead cleaning and cement monitoring.
ROV support to well operations, including hot stab intervention on the BOP and observation duties.
Drilling support - riser and LMRP monitoring, BOP intervention and guide base observation.
tasks: hot stab intervention on the BOP panel
monitoring of the riser and LMRP
ROV observation during landing of the BOP
tooling: the cleaning brush and cavitation lance

mooring.name: Mooring and riser campaign
scopes: ROV support to mooring installation, chain handling and riser monitoring.
Mooring scope - anchor and chain inspection, connector installation and pre-tensioning support.
ROV support to mooring and riser operations, including inspection of chains and connectors.
Mooring hook up - chain handling, connector make up and monitoring during pre-tensioning.
